noble:
Create a production pixel-art fighting-game animation keyframe sheet using the attached character as the STRICT identity reference. Preserve face, sex, costume, hat/hair, colors, weapon identity and detailed pixel art. Western male noble duelist, navy cape, feathered hat, white stockings, rapier and free-hand spell casting.
Output exactly 12 separate full-body sprites in a regular 4 column x 3 row grid, equal square cells on genuinely transparent background. Each cell has generous empty margins, NO labels, no panels, no ground shadow, NO particles/magic effects, no text. Every pose faces RIGHT, full body and weapon entirely visible. Match character body height and sole baseline across cells. Consistent anatomy, no duplicated limbs or swords.
Row 1, 4 poses NEW RANGED ATTACK: preparation drawing weapon/hand back, windup aiming forward, full extension release towards right, recoil returning to ready.
Row 2, 4 poses NEW FOURTH COMBO FINISHER: low compressed windup, large torso rotation raising sword, powerful forward diagonal finishing slash, grounded recovery. Make this a clearly different pose from standard thrust; keep planted feet and plausible two-handed greatsword grip for swordsmen/guardian, elegant rapier sweeping lunge for noble.
Row 3, 4 poses CHARGED RANGED ATTACK: braced charging stance holding sword/hand at chest, stronger crouched fully charged pose, explosive two-handed forward release (noble free hand casting with rapier raised), recovery. Stylized clean pixel art; stable character identity and body proportions across all 12. Project-bound sprite-sheet asset.
